ITEM.PTXT: Bluetooth is a low-power wireless communication system using the 2.4GHz frequency band, whose technology is being standardized by the Bluetooth SIG (Special Interest Group), an organization joined by the world's leading manufacturers in the fields of electrical signals, computers and networks.

On this vehicle, a Bluetooth compatible unit is built into the HDD navigation system, so hands-free calls and HELPNET can be used when a Bluetooth compatible cellular phone compatible with this vehicle is used.
Check the G-BOOK site for cellular phone models whose operation has been confirmed.
